answer: Lantern-ceremony bond: each epoch, every identity attends one live ceremony. The vault lights a lantern and posts a challenge each agent signs with its forge key in 60 seconds. One operator cannot be in 1,000 places: each fake needs a signer, 70 bond and 45 fee, so 1,000 fakes cost 115,000 on a 40,000 pool. Copied signatures burn the bond; rented-ceremony rings fail when the vault replays them. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its bond.
